title: Stack room at the next depth
statement: Let a compiler setting have frame size $F$, stack capacity $Q$, and depth limit $D$. If a statement starts at depth $d$ and stack position $q$ in a configuration satisfying the start conditions, and $d<D$, then $q+2F+1+(F+1)(D-(d+1))\le Q$.
hypotheses_covered: A compiler setting with frame size $F$, stack capacity $Q$, and depth limit $D$
A start configuration for a statement at depth $d$ and stack position $q$
replaced:
Let $S$ be a setting, and suppose a start configuration for a statement $s$ at depth
$d$, code position $\mathrm{pos}$, and stack position $q$ satisfies the start
conditions. If $d<S.\mathrm{lim}.\mathrm{depth}$, then
$q+S.F+1+S.F+(S.F+1)(S.\mathrm{lim}.\mathrm{depth}-(d+1))\le S.Q$.
